#!/bin/sh
# live-build chroot hook — configure Smash OS after packages install
set -e

echo "Smash OS chroot hook…"

# Default user for live: smash / smash (live-config may override)
if ! id smash >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd -m -s /bin/bash -G audio,video,plugdev,netdev,sudo smash || true
  echo "smash:smash" | chpasswd || true
fi

# Copy skel into smash home if empty config
if [ -d /home/smash ]; then
  mkdir -p /home/smash/Charts/Songs /home/smash/.config
  cp -a /etc/skel/.config/openbox /home/smash/.config/ 2>/dev/null || true
  cp -a /etc/skel/.config/tint2 /home/smash/.config/ 2>/dev/null || true
  chown -R smash:smash /home/smash
fi

# LightDM autologin for live feel (install ISO can re-enable greeter)
mkdir -p /etc/lightdm
if [ ! -f /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf.d/50-smashos.conf ]; then
  mkdir -p /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf.d
  cat > /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf.d/50-smashos.conf << 'EOF'
[Seat:*]
autologin-user=smash
autologin-user-timeout=0
user-session=smashos
greeter-session=lightdm-gtk-greeter
EOF
fi

# Prefer smashos session
# Disable heavy services we do not need
systemctl disable bluetooth.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl disable cups.service 2>/dev/null || true

# Python tooling venv (isolated, avoids distro package fights)
if command -v python3 >/dev/null; then
  python3 -m venv /opt/smashos/venv --system-site-packages 2>/dev/null || \
    python3 -m venv /opt/smashos/venv || true
  /opt/smashos/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip wheel 2>/dev/null || true
  /opt/smashos/venv/bin/pip install \
    "mido>=1.3.0" "numpy>=1.24" "soundfile>=0.12" "Pillow>=10.0" "librosa>=0.10.0" \
    2>/dev/null || true
  # Prefer venv python for smash tools
  if [ -x /opt/smashos/venv/bin/python ]; then
    sed -i '1s|.*|#!/opt/smashos/venv/bin/python|' /opt/smashos/bin/smash 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
fi

# Build Smash Drums Editor for Linux if node available and source present
if [ -f /opt/smashos/packages/smash-drums-editor/package.json ] && command -v npm >/dev/null; then
  echo "Building Smash Drums Editor (Linux)…"
  cd /opt/smashos/packages/smash-drums-editor
  npm ci --ignore-scripts 2>/dev/null || npm install --ignore-scripts || true
  node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs 2>/dev/null || true
  npm run build 2>/dev/null || true
  # electron-builder linux dir target if configured
  npx electron-builder --linux dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs 2>/dev/null || true
  # Link binary if produced
  for cand in \
    release/linux-unpacked/smash-drums-editor \
    release/linux-unpacked/Smash\ Drums\ Editor \
    dist/linux-unpacked/smash-drums-editor
  do
    if [ -x "$cand" ]; then
      ln -sfn "$(pwd)/$cand" /opt/smashos/bin/smash-drums-editor
      break
    fi
  done
  # Fallback wrapper: run electron on dist
  if [ ! -e /opt/smashos/bin/smash-drums-editor ] && [ -d dist ]; then
    cat > /opt/smashos/bin/smash-drums-editor << 'WRAP'
#!/bin/sh
cd /opt/smashos/packages/smash-drums-editor
export ELECTRON_START_URL=""
exec npx electron . "$@"
WRAP
    chmod +x /opt/smashos/bin/smash-drums-editor
  fi
fi

# Performance sysctl tweaks (light)
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-smashos.conf << 'EOF'
vm.swappiness=10
vm.vfs_cache_pressure=50
EOF

echo "Smash OS chroot hook done."
